newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombian peso ends lower on corporate dlr demand.
newsitem.headline: Colombian peso ends lower on corporate dlr demand.

text.p: Colombia's peso ended 2.45 pesos lower against the dollar at 1,077.95, falling under pressure from dollar-buying by the corporate sector and industrialists, interbank dealers said.
They said the peso rose in early trade, on sales of greenbacks by coffee exporters and foreign investors.
But the trend was reversed late in the session when demand for U.S. currency entered from airlines, chemical laboratories and industrialists seeking to make payments on imports.
"There was pent-up demand," one trade said of the dollar's sudden gain.
Dealers reported 281 trades for a total of $127 million. The peso moved in a 1,074.50 to 1,078.30 range.
